title: OMT protocol handshake and capabilities (v1)
description: Handshake negotiation (F1): the client offers its best protocol version and feature tokens; the daemon answers with the selected version (highest shared MAJOR, daemon's MINOR), its identity, the homes it exposes with stable HomeIds, and its limits/features. A request whose MAJOR is unsupported fails with problem code UNSUPPORTED_PROTOCOL instead of a handshake result.

ClientInfo.description: Self-description of the connecting client. kind selects the principal class used for parity enforcement (R22); name is informational.

kind.description: Principal class of the connecting client. adapter_only actions require dsh/desktop; cli/desktop/mcp/external map to their documented parity classes.

sessionId.description: Optional model-session identity (TICKET-0130 item 3): when present, the daemon derives a per-session actor namespace '<base>/<sessionId>' so concurrent sessions of one process are separately attributable at the trust gate.

RequestedScopes.description: Optional scope request of method handshake/request. The server derives every credential field; a client can never mint another principal's namespace or widen beyond open homes (R12).

actorNamespace.description: Requested delegated actor namespace. Honored ONLY when equal to the server-assigned base (<kind>:<pid>) or nested under it (<base>/<suffix>).

homes.description: Requested home scope; intersected with currently-open homes. Absent/empty means all open homes.

operations.description: Requested operation families ('node', 'run', 'events', 'ui', 'home') or '*'. Empty/absent defaults to '*'.

capabilities.description: Optional feature tokens the client understands (open vocabulary, e.g. "events.resume", "attention.payload.v1").

Limits.description: Bounded-resource limits enforced by this daemon (R21); clients must not exceed them. Exceeding a transient-capacity bound degrades with RATE_LIMITED; exceeding a durable-resource quota degrades with QUOTA_EXCEEDED (U5b).

maxListLimit.description: Upper bound of any limit/page parameter.

maxEventBatch.description: Upper bound of one events/resume page.

runConcurrency.description: Advertised run concurrency; values above it are rejected (plan: fixed at 1).

maxOpenHomes.description: Additive U5b: maximum simultaneously opened homes per daemon process.

maxConcurrentConnections.description: Additive U5b: maximum live client connections; excess connects degrade with RATE_LIMITED.

maxHomeQueueDepth.description: Additive U5b: maximum queued jobs per home actor; overflow degrades with RATE_LIMITED.

maxSearchTermBytes.description: Additive U5b: maximum UTF-8 byte length of a search term; longer terms fail with INVALID_INPUT.

maxIdempotencyEntries.description: Additive U5b: retained idempotent-operation registry rows; exhausting it degrades with QUOTA_EXCEEDED until retention prunes acknowledged rows.

maxRetainedEvents.description: Additive U5b: per-home outbox retention ceiling owned by the daemon; pruning emits a keyed snapshot.resync event.

Features.description: Named feature switches of this build. Open map so new features can appear additively; known flags are always present (false when unsupported).

eventResume.description: events/resume from a stored cursor is supported.

idempotencyKeys.description: Mutations accept idempotency keys (R9); seeded false until U5.

homeDeclare.description: Additive U5/R6: home/declare registers existing on-disk homes into the running daemon; clients gate the command on this flag (F4 version-drift fallback). Required in the schema because the post-U5 server ALWAYS emits it (true); clients still treat a missing flag as false when talking to pre-U5 daemons.

CredentialGrant.description: Server-derived scoped credential issued by handshake/request (R12/KTD9, formally registered U5b). The token is a 128-bit hex secret that exists ONLY in this response and the daemon's in-memory registry; it never appears in argv/env/logs/errors (secret redaction). Nothing client-supplied can mint or widen a grant.

token.description: Opaque bearer secret presented as params.credential.token on every subsequent request. Short-lived: dies at expiresAt or with the daemon generation.

principalId.description: Server-assigned connection principal '<kind>:<pid>'. Administrator capability keys on this id via the out-of-band admin-grants file.

actorNamespace.description: Delegated actor namespace for run claims/reports: the server-assigned base (<kind>:<pid>) unless an equal-or-nested scope was requested.

homes.description: Granted home ids (requested scope intersected with open homes).

protocolVersion.description: The negotiated version: shared MAJOR, daemon's MINOR.

homes.description: Homes visible to this principal, each with its stable HomeId (R4).
